headline: Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse Drive Fierce Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Since the previous edition, furious combat remains tightly concentrated in the northeast, where Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse serve as the sole theaters recording strategic base turnovers in the past two hours. Stlican Shelf registered eleven base shifts across contested strongholds including Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, while Weathered Expanse logged another nine exchanges and sustained over eight hundred casualties around Shattered Advance and Wightwalk. In Callahan's Passage and Linn of Mercy, immediate base conversions have halted over the past two hours, yet fierce engagements persist with heavy casualty rates mounting at The Latch and The Long Whine. Earlier flare-ups in Viper Pit and Marban Hollow have likewise calmed, leaving lines at Blackthroat and Mox static for the moment. Farther west, Stonecradle exhibits accelerating casualties and fresh enlistments despite no recent territorial shifts, while Godcrofts and Dead Lands remain quiet following earlier multi-base battles. The broader flanks and southern island sectors continue to report negligible engagement across the board.
